data.one_liner: Implementation of Bootstrap Icons in Flutter with over 2,000 icons.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 2,000 Bootstrap Icons for use in Flutter applications. Exposes icons through a straightforward Icon data class similar to standard Flutter icon sets.
use_when: You want to use Bootstrap Icons in your Flutter application
You need a large variety of general-purpose vector icons
avoid_when: You are already using an alternative icon set like font_awesome_flutter and want to keep app size minimal
You specifically require Material Design or Cupertino specific icons exclusively
strengths: Contains over 2,000 icons from the Bootstrap library
Easy drop-in usage via standard Flutter Icon widgets
weaknesses: Adds to app binary size if only a few icons are used
Not documented beyond basic icon inclusion

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Font Awesome icons instead of Bootstrap icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Lucide icons as an alternative icon set.
